summary: United States (US) localization of Business Central 29. It covers sales and use tax (tax areas, jurisdictions, external tax engine), IRS 1099 and 1096 reporting with IRIS, EFT and ACH payments, checks, bank reconciliation and deposits. It also carries North American reports and Mexican CFDI and Canadian tax pieces.
overview:
The US layer adds sales tax logic alongside VAT (General Ledger Setup gets a VAT in Use field). Tax Area, Tax Jurisdiction and Tax Detail tables, codeunit 398 "Sales Tax Calculate" and the posting codeunits (Sales-Post, Purch.-Post, Serv-Documents Mgt.) carry events and procedures for tax calculation, rounding, prepayments and an external tax engine. Learn documents basic tax setup, sales tax, use and purchase tax, and unrealized sales tax and sales payment discounts.

IRS reporting is a large block of its own objects: IRS 1099 form documents, form box calculation, IRIS transmission with OAuth, vendor email and printing, plus Form 1096, which is used to send paper 1099 forms to the IRS. Vendors, purchase documents, vendor ledger entries and journal lines get IRS 1099 fields. Learn covers setup, tracking vendor data, reporting and submission, legacy 1099 and the regulatory format changes.

Banking adds EFT export (ACH, RB, Cecoban, IAT) through data exchange codeunits, check printing helpers, bank reconciliation worksheets and deposits. The code also holds many NA reports, Mexican CFDI/SAT e-invoicing fields and objects, Canadian tax fields (GST/HST, provincial tax area), Yodlee, Ceridian payroll, Shopify tax matching, and GP and SL 1099 data migration.
key_points: Sales tax: Tax Area, Tax Jurisdiction and Tax Detail tables, codeunit 398 with external tax engine hooks, and tax events in sales, purchase and service posting.
IRS 1099 forms with IRIS submission, vendor emailing, printing and form box calculation; legacy 1099 and IRS 1096 forms also present.
Vendor, Vendor Ledger Entry, purchase headers and journal lines carry an IRS 1099 Code field; IRS 1099 Amount is on Vendor Ledger Entry, Purchase Header and the general journal lines.
EFT export for ACH, RB, Cecoban and IAT formats, with new fields on Bank Account and Gen. Journal Line.
Bank reconciliation worksheet, deposits and check printing are local objects, with source codes and number series in setup.
Unrealized sales tax is supported by new procedures in Gen. Jnl.-Post Line and VAT Entry; Learn also documents sales payment discounts.
Mexican CFDI/SAT e-invoicing: own e-invoice codeunits and pages, with CFDI and SAT fields on sales, transfer, customer and company tables.
Data migration from GP and SL for 1099 data, plus Ceridian payroll import and Yodlee bank feeds.

areas.what: Adds sales tax calculation (codeunit 398 with external tax engine hooks), tax detail rules, unrealized VAT handling in posting, and the whole IRS 1099/1096/IRIS reporting stack. Journal lines, VAT entries, G/L accounts and setup gain tax and IRS fields.

EFT export through ACH, RB, Cecoban and IAT codeunits, bank reconciliation, deposits and check printing. Bank Account, Check Ledger Entry and related pages gain fields and procedures.
areas.why: Learn documents bank reconciliation and deposit creation for the US.

areas.what: Sales tax on sales documents and posting, tax area on header, exemption and UPS zone fields, standard report totals with tax summaries, and CFDI fields on posted documents. Adds NA order, shipment and statistics pages.
Purchase tax, provincial tax and use tax posting, IRS 1099 fields on vendor and purchase documents, plus statistics pages and NA vendor reports.
areas.why: Learn covers use tax and purchase tax setup and vendor data tracking for 1099.

areas.what: Adds SAT and duty fields on items and transfer documents, vendor locations, and North American inventory reports.
Sales tax calculation in service posting and documents, NA table and page extensions, and tax statistics pages and reports.
Migration of 1099 data from GP and SL, with box mapping tables, logs, and settings page extensions.
Shopify tax match extension: tax area builder, matcher, review page and extensions of shop and order tax tables.
Upgrade codeunits, bank reconciliation and deposit permission sets, role profiles, and the CFDI Subject to Tax table.
Company Information gains US and Canada tax fields, plus Navigate, No. Series Line and source code setup changes for bank rec and deposits.
North American job and resource reports, plus extra fields on the Job Difference Buffer.
Ceridian payroll import with setup table, XML port, and permission set extensions.
Permission sets for the GP hybrid migration and changes to local and payables journal sets.
Document totals without rounding, copy document handling for sales tax and retention, plus assisted setup tax steps.
PEPPOL 3.0 North America format with install, upgrade and subscriber codeunits.
Data exchange definition changes to support EFT export types, and tax area code on Config. Setup.
Employee gains RFC and license fields, and HR and Payroll role centers.
Adds a US event subscriber for the expense agent.
Fixed Asset gains vehicle and SAT transport fields.

issues: The overview calls Form 1096 "the older 1096 form", which the input doesn't support. Learn describes Form 1096 as the form used to send paper 1099 forms to the IRS.

The overview says "replaces VAT with sales tax logic". The code adds a "VAT in Use" field and keeps VAT objects, and Learn lists reverse charge, so sales tax is added alongside VAT rather than replacing it.

A key point says Vendor and purchase documents carry IRS 1099 Code and Amount fields. Vendor and the posted purchase headers only add IRS 1099 Code. Amount is on Vendor Ledger Entry, Purchase Header, Gen. Journal Line and Posted Gen. Journal Line.

A key point says payment discounts are handled through new procedures in Gen. Jnl.-Post Line and VAT Entry. The added procedures cover unrealized VAT (CustUnrealizedVAT, VendUnrealizedVAT, PostUnrealVATEntry, GetUnrealizedVATPart), and none relates to payment discounts. Only Learn documents sales payment discounts.
The Mexican CFDI key point says "Shipped" and places e-invoice codeunits on tables. The codeunits are their own objects, and the fields extend sales, transfer and company tables.
